A place in the middle of an industrial park… a dark and isolated area, far from town.
Entry to the establishment (which doesn't reserve the right of admission) is completely arbitrary. They're just taking advantage of the limited nightlife options in Tarifa after a certain hour.

one_star_reviews.text:
I am quite surprised by the attitude of the staff who evaluate volunteer candidates for the home. My daughter had a traffic accident at the age of 20, having overcome a coma, a wheelchair, physical and brain rehabilitation, disability, etc., going from having to recover every vital function to studying Social Integration and being independent today and in the first interview they discarded her saying that she is not the profile they are looking for. She is a fighter who has overcome things that many of them cannot even imagine and that I believe could have contributed all of this to her work. A certain sensitivity and empathy, especially towards issues of vulnerability, is expected from the staff who work there and I have not seen it anywhere. All very politically correct but not very realistic, from what I see. As a professional in social services for more than 30 years, I am frankly disappointed.

I am saddened to read that the declared values ​​are those of being an "inclusive, empathetic, collaborative, responsible and persevering" organization, because they have not been at all inclusive or empathetic, much less responsible with it. Capacitism in a social entity? Sad, very sad.

one_star_reviews.text: Having lived in Altaona for two years, I would advise against buying property there. The community fees are a real rip-off. There are no invoices, the building management demands access to your account, and in exchange, maintenance of the common areas is never carried out. Countless repairs remain unfinished, not to mention the numerous structural defects in the buildings in the Alhambra 1 and 2 sections. The "urban identity" fees are completely exorbitant. You pay for nonexistent security; anyone can come and go freely without being checked. And I won't even mention the nuisances caused by the numerous Airbnbs. There's also the pervasive smell of pig manure in the area, and the pollution along the roads outside the development. In short, avoid it at all costs; it's a real trap.

one_star_reviews.text:
I bought a Cecotec Conga Y-80 robot vacuum cleaner for my house on July 27, 2026, and a week after buying it, it started making a very strange noise. I took it back to the store, and they told me it had to be sent to the service center (even though I had the 3-year warranty active). Three or four days later, they sent me a message saying they had an invoice for my robot vacuum cleaner, but I couldn't open it. At no point did they warn me that they were going to charge me anything, nor did they call to let me know. That same day I received the message, I called MediaMarkt, and they told me that MediaMarkt wasn't responsible for anything because, supposedly, it hadn't been properly maintained. They said I bought that robot vacuum cleaner FOR PETS, and because it picks up a few hairs, it's already getting clogged. Then I called again to check on the vacuum cleaner (it was supposed to have been shipped). A few days after the second call, I received a message saying it was at the store and I could pick it up. The next day, I went to pick it up, and they didn't have it. That same day I went to Carrefour and bought a Roomba, telling them I didn't want that robot vacuum anymore because I already had another one and I wanted my money back. Today, September 4th, 2026, I received a message saying the vacuum was back in store.

We'll see what happens on Monday when I go to pick it up, but I'm going to take the complaint form I filed on August 31st, 2026, to the town hall and file a report.

one_star_reviews.text:
​Terrible communication and unprofessional behavior

​I strongly advise international students and newcomers to be careful when dealing with this provider. My experience was deeply frustrating due to several major red flags:

​Extremely poor communication: They almost never answer phone calls, making it very difficult to get timely support or answers.

​Passive-aggressive attitude: When I simply exercised my right as a foreigner to ask normal bureaucratic questions about the rental process, the agent responded in a very passive-aggressive tone.

​Unfair rental pressure: While I was actively sending them the requested documents after confirming my interest, they told me: "Send the documents, but keep in mind that if someone books it on the website in the meantime, it's gone." They put pressure on you to rush, while keeping the room vulnerable to being taken by others despite ongoing agreements.
​Future tenants deserve transparency and basic respect. Unfortunately, this was completely lacking here.

Beside: At first we met to show me a room. Once there, the person in charge to show the rooms told me that he took the wrong keys and  only the lady who clean the apartment has a copy of them, but she wasn't there. So he tried to force the door, then told me we can met later that day to see another free room for an higher price. He didn't apologize for this inconvenient. Back that day, he said that it turned out that room has been rented: how couldn't you know if a room you are showing had been rented?

one_star_reviews.text:
A very disappointing experience.

I had already contracted several services with this firm and recommended them to at least five people because I trusted their work.

On Wednesday, I made an immediate payment to handle an immigration procedure. From Thursday onwards, I requested the information I urgently needed and had to insist again on Tuesday to receive it. By then, the company that was going to hire me had already decided not to proceed.

When I requested a refund, they withheld €50 for a consultation. However, the most disappointing thing wasn't just the money, but the way I was treated: instead of trying to understand my situation, I was accused of a supposed lack of respect, and it was insinuated that I was trying to take advantage of the firm.

I felt deeply offended. I understand that professional work has value, but I also believe that clients deserve respect, transparency, and proper attention.

one_star_reviews.text:
We want to publicly express our utter disappointment with OPA XXI after a long business relationship in which we entrusted them with a large number of policies. In a very short time, we have experienced two unacceptable situations for a brokerage/management firm in which we had placed our complete trust for years.

The first problem arose from a breakdown on the road near Palencia with one of our vehicles covered by a comprehensive policy with premium roadside assistance. Instead of arranging for the car to be towed to our trusted garage in Cantabria and suitable transportation to return home with our luggage, the only alternative they offered was two train tickets. Given such a deficient response for the coverage we had purchased, we had to pay out of our own pockets for both a private tow truck to move the vehicle and a rental car to return with our belongings.

The second incident is even more alarming: we discovered that another of our vehicles, which we assumed was fully insured, had been driven for nearly a year without any active policy whatsoever, without anyone alerting us. This left us completely unprotected against legal sanctions and, what is infinitely worse, exposed to enormous financial and personal liability in the event of a third-party claim or serious damages.
Our regular management has been handled by Gloria Crespo, and the service in these cases has been appalling. Given such a long track record and considerable business volume, we expected rigorous monitoring and professional oversight. In the insurance sector, oversights are not minor: they carry direct risks for the client. Both the lack of control in detecting the error and the subsequent silence are extremely serious, as to this day we have not received a formal explanation or an apology.
Two errors of this magnitude completely shatter any bond of trust. A true disappointment after so many years of working together.

The room cleaning was basic, the kitchen was disgusting, the refrigerator was rusty, and the floor was so sticky it felt like it had a magnet on it… It seems surreal that the owner also owns two other hostels; he clearly only cares about making money, not about the comfort of the pilgrims. one_star_reviews.text:
I don't like leaving bad reviews, in fact, this is the first one I've ever written... but I had to share this. A few months ago, I took my Fiat 500 to the mechanic because the engine was making a terrible noise, like a vibration or something similar.

The engine fault light came on, and I was able to see the diagnostic information and take some pictures, but that turned off the warning light... (my mistake).

When I took it in the first time, they told me that since the engine fault light wasn't on, they couldn't check it, even though I had the pictures of the fault codes and the car could clearly hear the strange noise it was making. They told me to drive it until the light came on again...

The engine fault light came on again, and the noises were getting worse and worse. I took it back, and they kept it for a couple of days... to my surprise, they replaced a surface-mounted part (an engine mount) and said that was the cause of the vibrations. They didn't even check it, they didn't pay any attention to the problem, nothing. When I left the garage, it sounded exactly the same as when I'd left it. And they told me to keep driving...

The third time I went, I refused to turn off the car until a mechanic came in person to listen to it. That's when they finally listened to me, and almost comically, they even seemed "scared" and told me I couldn't drive the car like that... after two previous visits where they didn't think it was anything serious. They kept it to check, but it was too late. They called me, and the repair was already too expensive. They told me that the engine would probably have to be replaced... and they told me to keep driving, this time to scrap the car.

I know I went in on time the first time, and if they had bothered to listen to me, a simpler fix would surely have been possible. But instead, they kept me driving around in a vehicle that wasn't roadworthy until it was finally beyond repair... money and time wasted, and I felt terribly helpless every time I took it back to find it in the same condition as when I left it.

I'm very disappointed with this garage, to be honest. If I had another car, I would never take it to this "garage" again.
Price assessment
Overpriced
Services

Long time costumer and user of yokohama tires, shocked with the position, sales and even worst posture of Yokohama in Portugal. A few months back i recomended a costumer to take his car to a tire shop in Portugal. This was non the less the firt "widow maker" in Porsche- 930 TURBO. The car had new tires but 15 years old. We had the chance to buy pirelli and maybe yokohama, but the rear tires were taking time to find . I said yokohama but i insisted i didnt want old tires, and shop owner said new tires are never more than 2 years. The car got delivered and that was it. Then i got antoher 930 turbo in the shop and this one had 10 year old tires, same thing , yokohama , and these were fitted in Spain. When the car got in i look at the car and the color of the tires was slightly brown , tipical of old tires. Checked the date and they were 4 years old. Made a claim in rodamos and he got a discount from yokohama spain of 600€ and that was it. Far from ideal, not correct to sell 4 year old tires as new but we acepted. At the same time we realized that the car we fitted the tires in Portugal had the same problem. Shop contacted them and the response from (resposible for spain and portugal ) was that until 10 years tires are consider new . Thats highly unaceptable specially when the yokohama page clearly says after 5 years tyres should be replaced and we all know the reason why. UV, and contamination. Plus we get a confirmation , recognition and discount from the car we fitted in spain and when the distributor is the same we get a diferent posture and solution for Portugal. Ive been trying to reach all help lines and zero aswer except from America that said they would pass on to the correct dep, but if they did , again it was ignored. How is it possible that one of the top brands in the market, is draining old stock in such an inresponsible and unworthy posture? For us although we recognize the quality of the product , it was the last time we bought because its clear distributors will sell defective or expired products as new and perfect.

I took my Seat Arona in because it had some problems that the garage said they couldn't fix and that I should take it to the dealership (the engine light was on and the EPC light came on sporadically). I took it in at the beginning of December 2025; it stayed there for two days, and they told me it was something to do with the brakes. They charged me, I took it back, and two days later the engine light came on again. I contacted them and took it back. It stayed at the garage for a few more days, and they told me it was because of the spark plugs, since they weren't the original Seat brand, and that could cause the engine light to come on (the spark plugs had been changed in July 2025). I paid for them (all this while paying for the car to sit there for a few days, which I didn't mind, as long as they fixed the problem, and if not, I didn't have to pay). I picked it up from the garage, and in less than a week the engine light came on again. I contacted them again (it's like Christmas time, but on weekdays) via WhatsApp because I had already contacted the mechanic that way and they weren't responding. The crazy thing is, I called and they told me not to worry about that warning light, that it was just a wire causing the "contact" and nothing to worry about. I paid almost €600 between the two visits and they didn't fix anything. I'm still having the problem and I'm looking for a private garage that can finally solve it.

one_star_reviews.text:
A Deeply Disappointing Experience

We didn't go to therapy because everything was perfect and we were doing great as a couple. We knew we had a problem, and that's precisely why we placed our trust in them: to work on our relationship and find tools to help us move forward.

However, the therapy ended unilaterally and unexpectedly by the therapist, Kaveri. She told us she considered us "aggressive people" and that she wasn't used to working with a couple like us. Something we consider completely unjustified. A couple disagreeing or interrupting each other shouldn't automatically make them "aggressive." We felt insulted.

She also recommended we find a mediator and, quite obviously, suggested we should get a divorce.

The worrying thing isn't that a professional can decide whether or not a relationship has a future. That decision belongs to the couple. What we expected from couples therapy was professional support to analyze our situation and help us reach our own conclusions, not for someone to make decisions for us or abandon the process when we needed it most.

We felt emotionally betrayed and abandoned by the very people in whom we had placed our trust.

Furthermore, the experience was plagued by recurring organizational problems: difficulties with session links, having to resort to Google Meet, and audio issues because the therapist didn't use a microphone and was sometimes barely audible.

But what ultimately disappointed us was the response we received when we formally filed our complaint. Instead of addressing the points we raised, explaining what had happened, or showing even the slightest self-criticism, we were simply told that one of us should pursue individual therapy and that, when we were both ready, we could return to couples therapy. We were given their link and invited to continue with them.

After all this, we have completely lost faith in this team. Couples therapy requires professionalism, empathy, the ability to manage difficult situations, and above all, trust. We lost all four.

We do not recommend this service, and we certainly would not entrust something as important as our relationship or individual therapy to them again.

one_star_reviews.text:
I've been a member for about two and a half years, and the only improvement is that they've replaced the specific parts on some of the machines that were literally falling apart and missing pieces. There are always broken machines, and the gym leaves MUCH TO BE DESIRED. It was closed for several days for maintenance, and there wasn't a single notification about it on Google or the app. But hey, if it's for maintenance (?) WELL, NO, they haven't fixed a thing. The same bike that's been broken for months is still broken after the "maintenance." Meanwhile, the same old instructor spends his time chatting while leaning against a treadmill or standing in the entrance, completely ignoring you. I used to say hi, but I'm done. I'm not going to waste my energy on this, honestly. The classes are AWFUL compared to other gyms, even other forums. I have to say the reception staff are all lovely, and I only have positive things to say about them, but between the lack of maintenance, the machines they don't fix, and the awful showers... there's no way I can or want to give a higher rating.
I really miss the yoga classes with the blonde Argentinian girl; they were fantastic, and you could tell she knew what she was doing. I keep coming because it's close and because I've been coming for a long time, but if I had to choose a center again, it wouldn't be this one.
Again, congratulations to the reception staff; you're great.

one_star_reviews.text: Terrible warranty management and illegal after-sales service. I bought a custom Mercedes steering wheel for €340, advertised as "like new." After only a few days of use, the upholstery started peeling because it was too short and there wasn't enough adhesive on the spokes. When I requested a solution via WhatsApp, the company's response was that they would send me a tool so I could fix it myself. When I refused, they expected me to pay for the round-trip shipping to have it repaired at their workshop in Jaén, or to come in person, claiming that "that's what their customers do." Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007 requires all businesses to handle warranties completely free of charge for the buyer, including shipping costs. When I reminded them of the law, they simply ignored my message and stopped responding. I am filing a formal complaint with the Consumer Protection Agency. I have attached photos of the defect and the chat where they disclaimed responsibility. I would not recommend them at all.

one_star_reviews.text: Very disappointed with this company due to their poor customer service. I was looking for a product they carry, and I wanted to make sure the dimensions would be right for me. I contacted their headquarters, and an operator told me to leave my phone number so they could send me the link via WhatsApp, which I did. After waiting a day and a half, I emailed them with the measurements I needed to check if they were compatible with the product they sell. The next day, I received a reply saying it would probably work. I thanked them and started placing the order online. Once I had submitted the order and was filling in the location and region, when I selected the Balearic Islands, a message popped up saying that for orders to the Balearic Islands, I should contact the company by phone. I called, and they answered. I explained my situation, and the operator said she would transfer me to the relevant department! After a few minutes on hold, the operator said she was busy and would call me back shortly! The next day, having received no response, I called again. When someone answered, I explained the situation, and they told me they "don't ship to the Balearic Islands" due to the shipping costs! Terrible quality and terrible handling of the complaint.

I ordered a planner and a teacher's notebook, and the result has been truly disappointing: blurry images, colors very different from the originals, stains and yellow outlines, see-through pages, poor binding, and very thin and flimsy lamination. Furthermore, they changed the order of the planner pages, so it doesn't match the design I sent.

I placed the order on Friday, and it didn't arrive until Tuesday, despite the advertised 24/48-hour delivery time.

The easiest thing would be to assume the problem is with my files, but the same planner and the same images were printed last year at a different print shop, and the difference in quality is enormous. I even printed the cover on my home printer, and it clearly looks better.

After receiving the order, I sent photos and videos showing all these problems. In fact, the photos show even less of how blurry it really is and the yellow outline that appears in the images, but the defects are still clearly visible.

However, instead of seeking a solution, the response focused on asking me where the content of the documents came from.

On Tuesday, they told me they would provide a solution. It's now Sunday, and I still haven't received any response or solution to the problem. I find it especially regrettable that, after sending all the evidence and explaining the situation in detail, I have to continue waiting without any kind of response.

In short, terrible quality, very poor finish, and completely unhelpful handling of the complaint and customer service. For €56, I expected, at the very least, a decent product and a bit of professionalism in resolving an obvious problem.

I wouldn't buy from them again.

one_star_reviews.text:
Our experience began with sky-high expectations from the medical team, which caused our hopes to soar, despite our detailed explanation of our complex medical history. However, after two unsuccessful transfers, the team's attitude changed drastically, justifying the results by citing the complexity of our case—the same medical history they had known from day one and which initially didn't seem to pose a problem.

Here's a brief summary of some of the errors and irregularities we experienced during our process:
1. Omission of essential tests: The karyotype test was not performed. After obtaining three negative results, the causes were not investigated, and the situation was attributed to bad luck.

2. Contradictory protocols: We were prescribed estrogen patches despite the presence of fibroids. Furthermore, when a transfer was canceled, one gynecologist advised us to continue without operating on the fibroids, while another recommended canceling the procedure and proceeding with the surgery.

3. Lack of management and information regarding the last transfer: On the scheduled date for the last transfer, the appointment was not in the system, unlike the two previous transfers where we had received prior confirmation in the days leading up to it and our appointments appeared in the hospital's automated system. Since we were not listed in the automated system, we went to admissions, where the appointment for the transfer was also not recorded. Finally, we inquired directly at the clinic, where the psychologist was present and confirmed that the appointment was not registered in the schedule. This raised serious doubts about whether the embryos were thawed correctly.

4. Lack of transparency: Relevant information regarding the embryo development date was withheld.

In conclusion, the lack of professionalism, disorganization, and absence of empathy during such a delicate time mean that we cannot recommend this center to others going through a similar process.

After dealing with this company for a long time, I have to say it's an absolute mess.

I've had several problems with deliveries. You always have to be on top of the delivery date, because if you're not sure how much water you have left two weeks in advance and you don't calculate it, and your delivery day falls on a holiday, they don't deliver it and they reschedule it for a day earlier or later; they just postpone it a week... imagine at Christmas when all the holidays fall on the same day!
Then there have been several days when they've told me they were out of stock, due to poor management, and they only tell me the day after the scheduled delivery, leaving me without water and without any warning, in a house with children.

Then recently, they told me they were out of stock due to a fire, which I could understand, given that it would take them three weeks to deliver. However, in the second week, they told me by phone that they had stock but weren't delivering because they were going in order of orders (understandable). But here's my surprise… they delivered to a relative of mine who had placed an order two days earlier, and I, who had placed an order on July 29th, didn't receive my order until July 13th—three weeks! And with that, you realize the huge lie they were telling me. No priority given to orders or anything; they simply didn't come to solve a problem that had been going on for two weeks.

Of course, if this were a hotel in Mallorca, they would have delivered the next day. Zero customer service, zero empathy, and zero desire to solve the problem. And my home is 1 km from their delivery base. To top it all off, when I cancelled my subscription, they wanted to come and collect my things the same day, but they couldn't even deliver water. Good luck to anyone who uses this service.

one_star_reviews.text: They don't answer the phone, you can call 100 times.
They don't deserve even one star. I've been calling for 5 days and nobody answers. If they don't want to work, they should leave the job for someone else.

I left a review a while ago giving them 3 stars, but now they don't even deserve one. This past year has been going downhill, and it's only gotten worse. They don't even care; they treat you like a guinea pig testing medication. Dr. Santiago left, and I was assigned a guy named David Esteban García. In February of this year, he decided to change my medication without even looking at me. I filed a complaint, and he still calls me, berating me for not reading the prescription. But they know perfectly well that when they prescribe double the dose, especially Pristip and Exital (which are the same drug), changing it from 50 to 100 mg, you have to take it little by little. I took a few until I finally got the dosage wrong, and they weren't even on the prescription anymore. Of course, it had expired; I'm not a mind reader. Instead of apologizing, he gets cocky. He has his own practice, and it's a shame they pay him to see patients. We're not animals; we're people who need help. As soon as he realized, they changed my psychiatrist. They've changed my appointment for the fifth time, then you go there, and the woman at the counter, who's been there for years and has a terrible reputation, treats you with a rude tone, even when you can file complaints there (I'm talking about the Rosell Hospital, etc.). She's a robust woman, they have her there because they have no other choice, but she doesn't know the meaning of manners. I see them all very nervous, and if you go there, firstly, it's not by choice, and secondly, it's to be treated well, because you're not out picking potatoes in the fields. Some of them really lack vocation, to be honest. I've been going for 11 years and it's getting worse every time. They just give you pills, listen to you for ten minutes, and send you home. And if you're lucky, they might give you an appointment soon, but nothing works; you have to file complaints, there's no other way. I hope these people calm down because there are people who are worse off, and a tragedy could happen any day.

At my last session with her, I arrived half an hour late. I told her I had to leave in half an hour and asked if I could come in, and she said yes, asking why I hadn't warned her earlier so she could get her act together (you have your own schedule, that's why you have appointments; you can be a little late, but not half an hour repeatedly). And then she has the nerve to charge for the whole session, knowing it's her fault. I absolutely do not recommend her; she only creates more stress. A month ago, she contacted me again, forcing me to go and talk to her so she wouldn't have to pay me for the half-session she owed me. After much talking and insistence via WhatsApp, I told her I had no interest in returning to her sessions, and that's when she refunded part of the session. Any changes I've made have been for work. She changes the schedule every week because she's just greedy and makes us feel like numbers. It's unbelievable how a mental health "professional" doesn't have to pass any kind of evaluation. She's a woman who won't leave you alone if you quit or write a bad review. I wrote the review two months ago, and three days later she politely asked if I would delete it. Since I didn't, she replied after all this time. You're shameless! Look out for your patients more and less for the money. I'm attaching screenshots of when she wrote to me and what I wrote back.

⭐ Terrible service. A disgraceful transport company.

My experience with Ontime has been appalling. My package was supposed to be delivered, and they marked TWO DELIVERY ATTEMPTS indicating that no one was home, which is completely false. Both days, there were people at the address waiting for the package.

The worst part is that no one contacts you, no one explains what happened, and when you try to speak to someone to resolve the issue, it's practically impossible. The phone line is just an answering machine, and on WhatsApp they tell you that an agent will contact you, but no one ever does.

Now the shipment is showing as an "INCIDENT," after two supposed attempts where, coincidentally, "no one was home." It's infuriating having to keep track of the package and then having delivery reasons recorded that don't reflect reality.

Terrible service, nonexistent customer support, and completely disappointing delivery management. I absolutely do not recommend this company. If I could choose the transport company, I would never use Ontime again.

one_star_reviews.text:
This company has over 1 million reviews and they have 1 star rating.  First lets talk about scams.  Do not call ANY UK numbers for assistance, they are scam numbers.  Anyone that speaks really bad english, if the phone line is bad, if they ask you to put apps on your phone or give you some sort of "Code" to put on your phone, if they only want to talk on the phone and not use a messaging service, it is a scam.  Disconnect the call immediately.

SEUR is such a bad company that SCAM groups have formed under the guise of "SEUR Support" because the real SEUR has no support.  Look on Google.  No "Working" phone number and no way to contact them via email.

I scheduled a pick up for my package to be shipped from my home to Madrid.  I chose the same day by 13:30 option.  I paid the cost (close to 33 Euros) and received automated responses, nothing human.  Well...SEUR never came by my house, never called, never emailed, never attempted to contact me.  I checked the app to see any updates.  All of a sudden, I see something that says my package was picked up.  Funny because it was on the table right in front of me as I read that.  So, I started looking for support options.  NOTHING anywhere.  I was directed to Facebook where I saw UK options.  UK Facebook page and phone numbers as well as the "Whatsapp" option.  I reached out via whatsapp and received a call from a man with a really strong African accent (Almost impossible to understand) we well as a statically infected phone line.  Two red flags immediately.  He asked for a screenshot of the request number, which he should have seen, he asked me to fill out and submit a form that asked for information already in my Seur online account, and sent me a "Code" and I knew it was a scam.  He then asked me to download an app.  I disconnected.  Yes, the scammers are not good people it's SEUR's fault because their horrible service makes it possible for them.  I will speak to an attorney but I want to bring this to everyones attention.  Stay away from SEUR.

They didn't even know how to drive the car when they got on it, even though it's an automatic, forcing it to shift gears. We heard it before we left. And to top it all off, they had the courtesy to clean the air filter, either by blowing on it or hitting it—a nice touch—only to then put the cover back on and tighten it with a machine, breaking all the plastic screw brackets and the cabin air filter cover. Two days later, it was on the floor. Something I still don't understand. Anyway, it doesn't take much to use the correct oil for each vehicle and handle things with care. I wouldn't take it there again, not even to vacuum it.

one_star_reviews.text:
I don't recommend it. I was referred there by my psychiatrist.

Months earlier, I had been diagnosed with anorexia, but at that time I had been suffering from bulimia for a few weeks, so I had gained some weight and my body no longer looked skeletal.

After speaking with Rosa (if I'm not mistaken about her name), her opinion was that I didn't have anorexia, or any other eating disorder. (Months earlier, I had been diagnosed with anorexia after undergoing several tests with a psychologist and psychiatrist at another clinic.) It's worth noting that she is a psychologist and was telling me this within the first 20 minutes of the first session. But she had already diagnosed me simply based on my appearance. I went there seeking help to stop my binge eating, which I was doing daily. What she told me was: if I maintained my weight at the next appointment the following week, everything would be fine, but if I lost weight, they would admit me to a day hospital. So, to get help, I'd have to see myself as anorexic again, because otherwise I wouldn't need it. That comment made me go a week without eating to show her how bad I was. In the end, I decided that wasn't logical and I never went back to the center.

Honestly, my sister is having a terrible time in there. She says there's a woman there who's constantly against her, that the psychologists are covering for each other, and that the staff in general is awful. My sister went in there with depression and has had several attempts since she was admitted. Can someone explain to me how she's worse off than when she arrived? You should be ashamed of yourselves.

🚨 DO NOT BOOK — Extremely unsafe and unprofessional

We paid $1,600 for a private charter and ended the trip after only about two hours because we genuinely feared for our safety.

The captain left the helm while the engine was running and asked my mother, who had never operated a boat, to steer. The boat came dangerously close to another vessel, and the captain had to urgently yell at her to turn the wheel to avoid a collision. He also repeatedly relied on passengers to assist with tasks that should have been handled by the captain/crew.

Even the marina staff questioned why the captain was operating alone.

We immediately contacted the company and requested a full refund, explaining the safety concerns in detail. We have now sent multiple emails over the course of more than a month and have received absolutely no response.

A dangerous experience is bad enough. Completely ignoring customers after a serious safety incident is unacceptable.

I would not recommend this company to anyone. Our experience was extremely disappointing and made us question the professionalism and integrity of the business.

We also found some of the prices excessively high in relation to the product being sold.

We were very disappointed both by the information received during the purchase and by the subsequent handling of the situation. We had high expectations and were hoping for a much better experience, so the disappointment was even greater. I highly recommend thoroughly researching the origin, manufacturer, and authenticity of products before buying.

one_star_reviews.text: The worst parcel delivery company. Every time I buy something, I dread it. I bought something on the 27th, and they had it on the 28th. They said it would be delivered on the 31st. It was delayed. Today, the 2nd, I checked this morning and saw it was out for delivery. At 4:14 PM, they sent me an email saying it would be delivered between 6:45 and 7:45 PM. At 5:47 PM, they said delivery was impossible due to absence (we were home) or closure, I don't know what that means, and that it would be delivered to a collection point. This isn't the first time they've done this to me. It's happened twice before; they've delayed deliveries because they said we weren't home, which was a complete lie. In one instance, I had to wait a week for them to resend the package, and in another, I had to go all the way to Getafe to pick it up. The service is awful.

This is the third time SEUR has done this to me. They say the address is incorrect and they don't call me to help. They leave me waiting for the delivery, and I have to go pick it up myself because I don't have a car.

You know what's worse? It's the same address Amazon uses for deliveries, and everything always arrives fine.

Because of the driver, I have to go to the SEUR office in Nobleja myself, even though I don't have a car, to pick up a package that weighs over 27 kilos. And to top it off, they only have limited hours, from 9:30 am to 1:30 pm, Monday to Friday. I can't go today, Saturday, to sort this out.

This company is truly terrible.

The food was great, and the service staff themselves were lovely and attentive. Unfortunately, the main issue seemed to stem from the restaurant manager, who appeared extremely stressed and was speaking to staff in a noticeably rude and abrupt manner. We even overheard an argument between the manager and a member of the team, which created a clear sense of tension throughout the restaurant.

It was disappointing to see the staff being spoken to this way, particularly as they were doing their best to provide good service. We also weren’t acknowledged when we arrived, and drinks we ordered never arrived but were still included on the bill.

Overall, the food and service staff were great, but the manager’s behaviour and the atmosphere he created significantly affected our experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
I would not recommend their services based on my experience, which I consider to have lacked professionalism, transparency, and ethics.

They interviewed me for the preparation of an expert report related to a matter of particular importance. Before hiring this service, I expressly stated that I needed a complete transcript of the interview, as it was required for the legal proceedings.

Subsequently, I repeatedly requested the transcript or, failing that, the recording of the interview. I received no response to these emails, nor did I ever receive either the recording or the transcript I requested.

Furthermore, the report included quotes attributed to me in the interview that, from my point of view, were demeaning and revictimizing, while the crime of which I had been a victim was not properly contextualized.

I also consider it particularly serious that I was not informed beforehand that they were a trainee.

My experience was, therefore, very negative. Given that this was a professional service related to legal proceedings and involving particularly sensitive information, I expected a much higher level of rigor, communication, and transparency.

I would never recommend it and I recommend checking other review profiles to verify its accuracy.

The worst part isn't the lack of transparency with which they manage these funded courses, but the utter lack of courtesy and professionalism of their staff: in my last phone call, when I simply asked for a logical explanation, they cut me off mid-sentence and rudely hung up on me.

A company that manages public funds and treats unemployed people and participants this way deserves absolutely no credibility. I do not recommend training here under any circumstances.

Terrible experience with Pedro. I had two sessions with him; the first one went well, but the second session caused me problems. And after writing to him this week, he hasn't responded. So I absolutely do not recommend his services.

The location of the villa is good, but unfortunately, that is the only positive thing.

Almost all of the furniture is in very poor condition. The beds and mattresses are extremely uncomfortable, and the sofas and chairs are worn out and not suitable for use. I absolutely do not recommend renting this villa as long as the furniture remains in this condition.

The kitchen cabinets have a strong moldy smell, and there are not even enough drinking glasses for the guests.

The doors are extremely noisy when opening and closing, and the refrigerator does not cool properly.

The listing also stated that a garage was included, but upon arrival we were told that the garage could not be used. This is unacceptable.

Overall, our stay was extremely disappointing. I would not recommend this villa at all unless the furniture and facilities are properly replaced and the issues are fixed.

A very disappointing experience. Upon arrival, we encountered several problems with the accommodation: the upstairs shower wasn't working properly, one of the toilet cisterns wasn't working, and the refrigerator had just been plugged in, so it barely cooled during our stay.

The worst part was that, after our stay, they deducted our deposit, claiming we had broken a ceramic hob, which we didn't do. We consider it completely unfair to hold us responsible for damage that could have already existed before our arrival.

If an accommodation has several maintenance issues and then tries to collect a deposit for damage the guest denies causing, I think the least they could do is properly check the damage before taking the money.

We would not return to or recommend this accommodation.

one_star_reviews.text: Stop! Please read reviews, this place charge an outrageous rate to exchange. They will tell you the exchange rate from GBP and then say it was a reversed rate and you didnt understand. This is not a trusted western union shop, even although their excessive signage would suggest otherwise. You must read the minute customer information placed as far away from the teller as possible and remove the receipt from the cashier holding it as the counter obstructs your view that you are signing for a ridiculous rate. Most exchanges would circle the amount to be revieved and verbalise this to ensure you fully understand. As soon as you sign that ticket, you have just lost a fortune. They will not cancel the transaction, even right away, will get aggressive and give you an email address to complain. They will then not answer the email for several hours and ask for the ticket to investigate. You have absolutely no way of getting your money back. Don't hand over your money as the transaction will go in a flash. It is incomprehensible that any organisation could be so dishonest and underhanded and get away with it.
